disable_device.name: Disable Device
disable_device.synergyNotes: Disarming traps, jamming mechanical mechanisms, or sabotaging mechanical contraptions (Rogues required for magical traps).

actions.name: Disarm Mechanical or Magical Trap
actions.description: Deactivate a tripwire, blade scythe, needle poison, or magical trigger safely without detonating it.

actions.name: Jam or Sabotage Mechanism
actions.description: Spike or wedge a locking tumbler, portcullis winch, or lever into a fixed jammed position.
